name: Definite-time delay qualifier for measuring relays
summary: Qualifier added to a measuring relay symbol to show that operation follows a fixed time delay after pick-up.
description: This qualifier is added inside or beside a measuring relay box to show that the relay operates a fixed time after its measured quantity crosses the threshold. Combined with a quantity such as I> or U<, it tells the reader the element is definite-time rather than instantaneous or inverse-time.

The qualifier states the type of delay, not its value. The delay setting itself must appear in the settings table, and an element shown without any time qualifier should not automatically be assumed to be instantaneous unless the legend says so.
readingNotes: Read the qualifier together with the quantity and threshold sign.
Take the actual delay value from the settings record.
distinction: A definite-time qualifier gives a fixed delay; an inverse-time qualifier gives a delay that shortens as the quantity increases.
